title: BrowserControlCapability
description: One row of the browser-control tooling capability matrix: for a given tool/category, what was checked, which commands were actually run, whether it is available here, its 17-flag capability profile, its risks, and a routing recommendation. Fed by the tooling survey (probe_browser_control_tools) and by browser_control.BrowserAdapter.capabilities(). The 17 `capabilities` flags are the single source browser_control.adapter.CAPABILITY_KEYS; browser_control/self_test.py fails if the two drift. candidate; serves_truth=false.

category.description: the capability family or backend, e.g. static_http / cdp / playwright / remote_browser / extension / mcp / llm_agent

adapter.description: the browser_control adapter name backing this row, if any

commands_run.description: the actual commands executed to establish availability (evidence, not assertion)

available.description: usable in THIS environment right now (deps present + a probe succeeded)

status.description: implemented = real adapter here; available = deps present, launchable; seam = documented design stub; degraded = importable but could not launch; unavailable = deps/keys absent

risks.description: e.g. agent-written helpers QUARANTINED; 'any client acts as the logged-in user' -> auth gate; requires an absent cloud key

recommendation.description: the routing verdict — when to prefer this backend and when to route elsewhere
